subject: Subject: Mirei (米芮), a female child goblin, the middle of Chik's three younger siblings, older than the smallest boy but younger than the adolescent. Sage/jade-green skin, thoughtful blunt goblin face, wide pointed sideways ears with slight downward angle, amber-brown eyes looking carefully ahead. Dark brown hair neatly arranged in two LOW short braids, plain tiny cloth ties, no jewels. Wears a modest fully covering pale grey-beige long sleeve tunic with a faded indigo-blue patched work apron. She carefully holds a small grain-pouch drawstring knotted cord between her hands at the bottom of the bust; a corner of the coarse cloth pouch is visible. Slight knitted eyebrows and matter-of-fact calm, cares by counting and dividing food. Noticeably goblin; NOT a human girl with green paint or elven facial proportions. No adult feminine body proportions, no weapon, no smiley mascot.
